2. **Check OMITTED_CRITICAL:** No complete deletion of major facts present in sources *and* baseline. Core negatives (breaches, 20% CSAT drops, revenue flat/misses, CAC surge, outages) are explicitly included. Minor omissions (e.g., Apex "slight" operating income contraction/R&D, Nebula legacy stagnation/friction in renewals) are not "major" relative to bolded breaches/CSAT or financial headlines; positives like Apex debt reduction/contract retention are also softened but not hidden.
